answer_1.quote: the text-to-SQL task aims to produce a legal and executable SQL query that leads directly to the correct answer

answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics for the text-to-SQL task include component matching, exact matching, and execution accuracy.

answer_4.quote: We ask two annotators to reformulate pseudo questions into NL questions, and filter two kinds of questions: 1) incomprehensible ones which are semantically unclear; 2) unnatural ones which are not the focus of humans.
answer_4.guideline: filter incomprehensible and unnatural questions, check correctness of reformulated questions
